entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • BlazorWebView: model blazor.modules.json as a Framework asset (fixes publish-time Sequence contains more than one element in MAUI Blazor Hybrid + RCL) #67374
  • Hot reload: scope ShouldRender bypass to first render per component to prevent unbounded re-render loop (OOM) #67371
  • Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http 2.3.x packages don't clearly indicate they are only intended for ASP.NET Core on .NET Framework #67370
  • Blazor analyzer public `[Parameter]` code fix fails to replace multiple modifiers #67364

Closed

  • API proposal: Allow OpenAPI registration to resolve document names upon request #66725
    11.0-preview6
  • API Proposal: Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenAPI Not Extensible Due To Internal Types #66408
    .NET 11 Planning
  • Perf regression: antiforgery-noop #67361
  • API review feedback: BrowserConfiguration shape/placement (#66393) #67336
  • HostFiltering middleware improperly matches hosts with leading dot #66652
  • Perf improvement: multiple_queries #67358
  • [aw] Issue Triage Agent for dotnet/aspnetcore failed #67201

PullRequests

Created

  • Add nullable enum OpenAPI coverage for body and non-body inputs #67373
  • Hot reload: scope ShouldRender bypass to first render per component to prevent unbounded re-render loop (OOM) #67372
  • [Blazor] Rename EnvironmentBoundary component to EnvironmentView #67369
  • Fix culture persistence to not have public API #67367
  • Synchronize docs/list-of-diagnostics.md with codebase #67366
  • fix(blazor,analyzer): parameter attribute code fix multi-modifier handling #67365
    community-contribution
  • Add IsValid property to ValidationStateChangedEventArg #67362
    community-contribution

Merged

  • [Blazor] Rename API to NavigationManager.GetUriWithFragment #67368
  • Allow OpenAPI registration to resolve document names upon request #66692
    feature-openapi, area-minimal
  • Use globalized type names in validations gen #67363
  • Harden host filtering middleware matching leading dot when using wildcard #67265
  • Reshape BrowserConfiguration API per review (BrowserOptions) while preserving the JS wire format #67337

Updated

  • [Blazor] Model WebView blazor.modules.json as a framework asset (#67374) #67375
  • Add SignalR Auth Refresh support to server and .NET client #67111
    area-signalr
  • Add `ConfigureHostApplicationBuilder` virtual method on WebApplicationFactory to allow early configuration of the host application builder #66527
    area-mvc
  • Fix cross-origin POST to a named CORS policy wrongly rejected by default CSRF protection #67307
    feature-antiforgery
  • Improve CRLF / LF line terminators observability in HTTP/1.x request #66807
    area-networking
  • Add review-public-api Copilot skill #67335
  • Implement async validation support for Microsoft.Extensions.Validation #66487
    area-minimal, feature-validation
  • Circuit can be paused by Blazor when inactivity is detected #67098
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview6
  • Add warning and code fix suggestion for non-public `[JSInvokable]` methods #67137
    area-blazor, analyzer, community-contribution
  • Ignore From when serializing a JsonPatchDocument for add, remove, rep… #64457
    feature-json-patch, community-contribution, pr: pending author input, pending-ci-rerun, area-minimal
  • Fix json parsing for XML examples in OpenApi #67135
    area-mvc
  • CacheBoundary support for Blazor #65772
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview6
  • Fix Blazor TextArea Not Updating #67088
    area-blazor
  • Fix QuickGrid InvokeAsync exception when calling RefreshDataAsync method #66825
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • Fix Invalid Trim Warning Suppression in BindConverter.cs #66997
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • Fixed AmbiguousMatchException in DataAnnotationsValidator for Hidden Members #67075
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • Add InputSelect analyzer to warn about nullable TValue without empty option #67060
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • Improve Blazor async form validation #67323
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview6
  • Fix null reference issue caused by validation exception when circuit is disposed #67146
    area-blazor
  • Add CellClass support to PropertyColumn and TemplateColumn in QuickGrid #66999
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • Make PathString.StartsWithSegments treat backslash also as a boundary #67093
    area-networking
  • Add test case for two leading dots #67266
  • Add warnings for incorrect spacer element usage based on parent element #66968
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • Add object-level validation APIs to EditContext #67178
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • Provide custom comparer support for in-memory QuickGrid sorting #67035
    area-blazor, community-contribution
